name: sre-sli-slo-management
description: Use when the user asks to define SLOs and an error budget policy, SLIs, burn rate alerts, multiwindow multi-burn-rate alerting, SLO math, availability or latency targets, Sloth, Pyrra or OpenSLO. Produces SLI definitions, targets, budgets and Prometheus alerts. Not for SRE program design (use devops-sre-practices) or contractual SLAs (use enterprise-sla-management).
